name: photon
description: Agentic coding with small local LLMs via Ollama or llama.cpp — tuned so low-end models actually cope.

photon.ollama.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama server.

photon.ollama.requestTimeoutMs.description: Idle timeout (ms): how long to wait between streamed tokens before giving up. Not a cap on total generation time — slow models can run as long as they keep producing output.

photon.llamacpp.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the llama.cpp server (without /v1). llama.cpp exposes an OpenAI-compatible API at <baseUrl>/v1/chat/completions.

photon.providers.llamacpp.enabled.description: Enable llama.cpp local models (OpenAI-compatible at photon.llamacpp.baseUrl). No API key required.

photon.defaultModel.description: Model selected by default. Empty = first available model.

photon.interfaceMode.description: Engine stack: local = Ollama models with adaptive tuning; cloud = direct provider APIs with native tool calling, no adaptive limits, and no local models.

photon.context.reserveOutputTokens.description: Tokens reserved for the model's reply when budgeting the context window.

photon.tools.autoApprove.description: Auto-approve tool actions (file edits, terminal). When false, Photon asks before side effects.

photon.adaptive.enabled.description: Let Photon auto-tune settings, prompt shape, and tool protocol to the machine + model.

enumDescriptions: Auto — pick the level from the model + machine.
Maximum — fully refined prompts, all tools, longest output. For capable models.
High — elaborated prompts and multi-file workflow guidance.
Low — compact prompts and few tools for weak models / tight context.
photon.intelligence.level.description: How much prompt/tool machinery Photon gives the model. Higher = smarter but heavier on context.

photon.webSearch.provider.description: Provider used by the web_search tool.

photon.index.enabled.description: Index the workspace locally (offline, via a local Ollama embedding model) so Photon can retrieve relevant code for a request. Requires the embedding model below to be pulled.

photon.index.embeddingModel.description: Local Ollama model used to embed workspace code for indexing. Pull it with: ollama pull nomic-embed-text

photon.providers.gemini.enabled.description: Enable Google Gemini cloud models. Set your API key in the Photon settings panel (stored securely in VS Code secrets).

photon.providers.claude.enabled.description: Enable Anthropic Claude cloud models. Set your API key in the Photon settings panel (stored securely in VS Code secrets).

photon.providers.nvidia.enabled.description: Enable NVIDIA NIM cloud models. Set your API key in the Photon settings panel (stored securely in VS Code secrets).

photon.providers.openai.enabled.description: Enable OpenAI cloud models (GPT-4o, o-series). Set your API key in the Photon settings panel (stored securely in VS Code secrets).

photon.providers.openrouter.enabled.description: Enable OpenRouter cloud models. Set your API key in the Photon settings panel (stored securely in VS Code secrets).

photon.providers.opencode.enabled.description: Enable OpenCode Zen cloud models. Set your API key in the Photon settings panel (stored securely in VS Code secrets).

photon.providers.blackbox.enabled.description: Enable Blackbox AI cloud models. Set your API key in the Photon settings panel (stored securely in VS Code secrets).

photon.experimental.harness.description: Experimental: run turns through the harness AgentLoop + SessionRegistry (event-sourced) instead of the legacy AgentEngine. Keeps the same tools, plan, and webview. Restart required.

photon.providers.custom.description: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints (OpenRouter, Groq, OpenAI, etc.). Each entry: { id, label, baseUrl, apiKey?, models?, extraHeaders?, keyInBody? }.

id.description: Unique provider id (used as the model prefix, e.g. 'openrouter').

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the /chat/completions endpoint, e.g. 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1'.

apiKey.description: API key. Prefer leaving empty and entering it in the settings panel (stored in secrets).

models.description: Model catalog. Each: { name, label?, contextLength?, toolTrained?, vision? }.

keyInBody.description: Send the API key in the request body instead of an Authorization header.

scripts.build: npm run build:webview && npm run build:ext
